positions.description: Skills: Selenium · Regression Testing · Test Automation · Agile Methodologies · Agile Testing · C# · Software Testing · Jira · Test Cases · Software Quality Assurance · System Integration Testing

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
- Develop, document and maintain functional test cases and other test artifacts of six different web applications that also included our customer facing website and store. 
- Responsible for verifying overall systems and third party integration within our apps including but not limited to Mailchimp, Salesforce, Webex, and Zoom with emphasis on integration and functional testing
- Creating and updating manual black box system and regression test scripts utilizing Selenium IDE
- Utilize Jasmine based automation tool, Protractor, to create new end-to-end test of our five new AngularJS web applications 
- Manage Zendesk customer support tickets queue by validating and prioritizing reported issues into Jira, collecting information and communicating status as needed to original reporter, ensuring tickets are prioritized and resolved in a timely manner
- Active participation in daily scrum as well as agile sprint planning

positions.title: IT Systems Admin
positions.description:
- Manage over a dozen on-site and co-location linux and windows based servers
- Oversee the headquarters Asterisk (PBX) phone system including the on-site call center with 20 advisors
- Responsible for tracking company IT equipment while also performing any hardware maintenance & upgrades on Apple & Windows laptops, desktops and servers
- Establish company-wide ticketing system with Zendesk to process and manage any internal IT or software support issues

positions.title: Customer Support Manager
positions.description:
- Handled over 1500 hours of troubleshooting via support calls from users all over the country. 
- Conducted webinar trainings and demos for current and potential clients 
- Closely worked with the development team to report and escalate software bugs and feature request
- Facilitated the sales process for 10 sales reps  by updating leads, creating quotes, and sending out invoices via Netsuite
- Managed my own book of business bringing in over $50,000 of sales.
- Facilitated in closing large multi-school/district deals in excess of $250,000
- Managed ad-hoc email marketing campaigns via MailChimp

positions.title: Software Consultant/Staff Accountant
positions.description:
- Implemented and configured accounting software while providing training and support to new and existing clients via email, phone, remote connection or in-person. 
- Performed analysis, testing, conversion and integration of data through spreadsheets and database tools, MySQL.
- Coordinated on-site ad-hoc hardware implementation projects for clients.
- Played an instrumental role in the development and execution of sales reports using Crystal Reports.
- Reviewed and organized workpapers for internal and external audits.
- Assisted in the preparation of client corporate and personal tax returns using Lacerte.

positions.title: Staff Accountant
positions.description:
- Directed monthly accounting cycle to include preparation of financial statements, month-end close, various journal entries, accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger maintenance.
- Reconciled various revenue, current and noncurrent asset, short-term and long-term liability accounts to maintain effective internal control.
- Prepared timely compliance and Sales and Use tax filings for the Anaheim Tourism Tax and Occupancy Tax.

positions.title: Jr. Network Systems Administrator/Help Desk Support
positions.description:
- Supported 10 Hotels and 1 corporate office (100-150 users) with IT related issues including but not limited to installations, troubleshooting, repairing, file recovery and software training remotely and on-site.
- Assisted with the maintenance and configuration of servers: Active Directory 2003, Microsoft Exchange 2008, Blackberry Server, VMware, and smaller scale File, Print, and Terminal servers.
- Repaired any damaged hardware ranging from replacing LCD & keyboards to rebuilding CPUs.
- Ensured that user had access to the system remotely and on-site through Remote access or VPN (PPTP/IPSec).
- Renegotiated the MPLS (hotel network) contract resulting in savings of 20% per month for every hotel.

allTitles: Jr. Network Systems Administrator/Help Desk Support
